architecture: Historical18V A0 reference; battery architecture reopened for festival use. USB optional, not required.
release: NOT_RELEASED; data/wiring_procurement.json and data/battery_study.json supersede older selection notes

items.note: Already integrates amplifier, ADAU1701 DSP and Bluetooth. No extra MCU or BT receiver required. No charging circuit.
Keep pack closed; no charging through JAB3; OEM-temperature and undervoltage shutdown at foreign adapter not established.
Covered contacts, keyed polarity, retention, fuse access and confirmed protection interface required. Battery mount/hood not dimensioned without exact pack/adapter.
257 series obsolete according to manufacturer. 32V series; verify specific interrupt rating, inrush I2t, holder and temperature derating. Place within planned 50mm of pack adapter positive contact.
DC-rated, touch protected, >= planned branch rating; wire and sealing compatible with selected fuse.
Recessed female contacts on battery side. 13A stated. Manufacturer moisture rating only for specified correctly mated assembly. Cap unused live side.
Include wedges, contacts, seals, crimp tooling and strain relief; housing alone is not a finished connector.
AT06-2S-CAP family documented. Confirm cap against chosen connector side, especially hot battery connector when unplugged.
Qualified MOSFET or module, transient/current envelope and thermal loss not designed yet. Keying alone is insufficient assembly verification.
Load-dependent threshold, hysteresis, restart and pack protection interface require bench data. 15V is only a project trial value, not a cell-safety guarantee.
DC voltage, interrupt current, inrush and environmental sealing must be specified; standby is not battery isolation.
Nonpolar series part; check measured HF impedance, startup/reset and crossover. Does not replace DSP peak/RMS protection.
Programmed DSP, EEPROM boot image, readback, channel mapping and mute/reset tests absent.
See data/wiring_procurement.json; no external insert-plate or rejected E04 exterior.
See data/wiring_procurement.json; no external insert-plate or rejected E04 exterior.
Sealed bay has no qualified heat path yet. Verify heat-sink potential, isolation and worst-case closed-box temperature; no unsealed ventilation holes into wet acoustic space.

J8.qualification: Pin-1 orientation and supplied connector revision must be checked on actual board

J10.qualification: Right pair 1/3; left pair 4/2. Confirm with low-level bench measurement before assigning LF/HF. Neither negative output is common ground.

JAB3_connections_from_W04.J5: ICP5 programming, accessible only behind service cover
JAB3_connections_from_W04.J7: Line output; not a third powered speaker channel

notes_E05: Two internal M16 speaker glands, no exterior DC outlet selected.
